title.narrative: TB LON APS: Alliance for Combating Tuberculosis In Bangladesh (ACTB)

description.narrative: (Bangladesh): Alliance for Combating Tuberculosis in Bangladesh (ACTB) activity contributes to the reduction of tuberculosis (TB) by strengthening systems for TB diagnosis, treatment, and prevention and evidence-based decision making, including for battling stigma and discrimination. ACTB will improve the identification of TB cases; ensure access to quality, patient-centered care for TB and drug-resistant TB; prevent transmission and disease progression; and strengthen TB information platforms through public and private sector channels. With FY 2024 funds, ACTB will provide national and sub-national support to the National TB Control Program (NTP) to increase case notification and improve treatment outcomes for all forms of TB. ACTB will improve early-stage TB detection; scale up the provision of shorter treatment regimens and new drugs for drug-resistant TB; and increase preventive therapy for people exposed to TB. It will also enhance the capacity of the NTP to conduct clinical assessments and diagnosis of TB in children. Moreover, the activity will support NTP to implement its strategic plan; address TB programmatic gaps with locally generated solutions; and highlight potential areas that necessitate further research and policy advocacy. ACTB will work closely with different divisions of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, local governments, and municipalities to improve infection prevention, case diagnosis, notification, and treatment in selected areas of Bangladesh. The activity will support the Joint Strategic Plan Goal Three and ICS Mission Objective Three. The activity will advance the Indo-Pacific Strategy by working with GoB to intensify efforts to prevent, detect, and respond to infectious diseases.Funding will contribute to Digital Technology-Indirect ($150k), Innovation ($100k),Gender Equality ($500k), Health Workforce ($800k), PGI- Indirect- Digital($550k), PGI-Indirect Health ($4.4m),PSE ($500k).
